_doc: Brawl: a free-for-all of 2 to 4 fighters, each on their own team with one life. Last one standing wins; at time, the healthiest. Spawns are fractions of the floor, one per slot. Chaos Cup plays these rules with three random mutators (data/rules/mutators.json) on top. Times are in ticks (60 per second) unless named _seconds. Shrines ("shrines", over data/rules/shrines.json): one in the middle that a fighter claims alone, haste then might, first ready 12 s in, then every 25 s. The crown ("crown": true): a KO is credited to the victim's last hitter if that hit landed within credit_seconds. While nobody wears the crown (the start, or after its holder fell with nobody's hit behind it), the next credited KO gives it to the killer; KOing the holder takes it. The holder scores crown_points_per_second. At time the healthiest standing fighter wins, and crown points break a near tie: among those within crown_tie_margin (a share of health) of the healthiest, the most crown points wins. crown_points_to_win > 0 also wins outright on reaching it (0: off). The CPU pulls toward the holder by crown_cpu_pull px.
